title: Ambient frequency from restricted Fourier support
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $p:\{ -1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and fix signs $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. Let $e:\{0,\ldots,k-1\}\to J$ be a bijection, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. If $S$ belongs to the Fourier support of the restriction of $p$ to the free coordinates, reindexed by $e$, then there is a set $T$ of coordinates outside $J$ such that the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at the union of the ambient lift of $e(S)$ and the lift of $T$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$p$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$z$ is a fixed assignment of signs outside $J$
$e$ is a bijection from the $k$ coordinates to $J$
$S$ is a subset of the $k$ coordinates
$S$ is in the Fourier support of the reindexed restriction of $p$ at $z$
